# CiteMe

> CiteMe is a free academic citation generator that searches 250M+ sources and supports 40+ citation styles for papers, books, and DOIs.

CiteMe provides comprehensive citation tools for students and researchers, including generators for major styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver), conversion tools for DOIs, ISBNs, and URLs, and verification features to detect fabricated or AI-hallucinated citations. The platform integrates with academic databases like CrossRef, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar.

- MLA citation

## Citation Style Generators

- [APA Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/apa-citation-generator): APA 7th edition citation generator with in-text citations and bibliography formatting.
- [MLA Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/mla-citation-generator): MLA 9th edition Works Cited and in-text citation generator for essays and papers.
- [Chicago Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/chicago-citation-generator): Chicago 17th edition and Turabian citations in notes-bibliography and author-date formats.
- [Harvard Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/harvard-citation-generator): Harvard style citation generator for UK and Australian universities with reference lists.
- [IEEE Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/ieee-citation-generator): IEEE numbered reference format for engineering, computer science, and electronics.
- [Vancouver Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/vancouver-citation-generator): Vancouver numbered citation format for medicine, nursing, and health sciences.
- [Citation Styles Overview](https://citeme.app/styles): Citation style selector for APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver, and 60+ formats.

## Conversion & Metadata Tools

- [DOI to Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/tools/doi-to-citation): Convert DOI or doi.org links to citations in 40+ styles using CrossRef metadata.
- [ISBN to Citation Converter](https://citeme.app/tools/isbn-to-citation): Book citation generator from ISBN with BibTeX export for LaTeX workflows.
- [URL to Citation Extractor](https://citeme.app/tools/url-to-citation): Extract metadata from webpage or article URL to generate citations in 40+ styles.
- [PMID to Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/tools/pmid-to-citation): Convert PubMed IDs to medical citations in Vancouver, AMA, APA, and biomedical styles.
- [PDF to BibTeX Converter](https://citeme.app/tools/pdf-to-bibtex): Extract references from PDFs and export verified matches as BibTeX for LaTeX.

## Citation Verification & PDF Tools

- [Reference Checker](https://citeme.app/tools/reference-checker/check): Verify bibliographies against academic databases to detect AI-hallucinated and fabricated citations.
- [Citation Checker](https://citeme.app/citation-checker): Verify references against academic databases; detect AI-hallucinated and fabricated citations.
- [PDF Citation Generator](https://citeme.app/tools/pdf-citation-generator): Extract and verify references from academic PDFs, export in multiple citation formats.

## Learning & Guides

- [Citation Guides](https://citeme.app/guides): Comprehensive guides with formatting rules, examples, and best practices for all major citation styles.

## Tools Hub & Pricing

- [Citation Tools](https://citeme.app/tools): Main tools hub for DOI, ISBN, URL, and PubMed ID citation generation and conversion.
- [Pricing Plans](https://citeme.app/pricing): Pricing plans: free tier (25 citations/month), Pro from $2.99/week with unlimited citations.
